evals.prompt: /structure-outline .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-310-product-wishlist flow: design — the task directory holds 01-request-product-wishlist.html, 02-research-questions-product-wishlist.html, 03-research-product-wishlist.html, and 04-design-discussion-product-wishlist.html (status ready-for-structure, all open questions resolved). Break this into vertical slices with checkpoints.
evals.expected_output: A structure outline written to .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-310-product-wishlist/05-structure-outline-product-wishlist.html with an Implementation Overview, header-style signatures, a file inventory, vertical slices each with a checkpoint plus Automated and Manual verification, integration points, and a rollback strategy, followed by an open-for-review offer and an /orchestrate handoff
expectations: Reads the request, research, and design-discussion documents from the task directory in full before writing
Output contains a New types & signatures section with TypeScript interface/type definitions (signatures only, no implementation bodies)
Output contains an Implementation Overview checklist with one unchecked item per slice, in slice order
Output contains at least 2 vertical slices, each touching multiple layers (e.g., database + API + UI), not a single horizontal layer

Each slice card follows the slice-card contract: a `### Slice N — Name` heading, a goal line, a files-touched list with NEW / MODIFY / DELETE tags, a checkpoint line prefixed with the checkpoint marker, an Automated verification list naming the repository's actual commands, and a Manual verification list of human-only steps

Each slice card has a Change outline (full target shapes for new code, focused diff blocks for changed shapes) and a Tests (following the repo's existing patterns) block naming test types and locations modeled on the repository's existing tests
Slices are ordered so dependencies flow forward (Slice N+1 depends on Slice N, never reverse), with a hardening slice last unless each slice carries its own error paths and tests
Output contains a File inventory listing new and modified files with NEW / MODIFY / DELETE tags
The render brief uses only the established slot names (PHASE, PHASE_LABEL, STATUS, STATUS_CLASS, TOPIC, TITLE, TICKET, PROMPT_TEXT, META_EXTRA, SUMMARY_EXTRA) and does not invent new slots

META_EXTRA includes crispy:task_dir, crispy:flow (design), crispy:repos, crispy:request_doc, crispy:research_doc, crispy:design_doc, and crispy:slice_count, with doc links pointing at .agents/artifacts/ paths
Delegates rendering to Skill('output-html') with the stem .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-310-product-wishlist/05-structure-outline-product-wishlist, PHASE=structure and STATUS=ready-for-implementation

Ends by offering to open the document for review (VS Code, Cursor, or browser) rather than offering to commit it, names `/orchestrate .agents/artifacts/feat-ENG-310-product-wishlist flow: design` as the next command with `/create-spec` as an optional alternative, says it can run here, after compaction, or in a new session, and then waits
